messages:
Maria Gomez: AMX asked for Redwood-verified perf/W and throughput for a marketplace listing. Need KPIs + runbook.
Jake Turner: OK. Which model sizes and seq lengths?
Maria Gomez: 13B and 30B; seq 512 and 2048. Targets: p95 latency <250ms at 512 (latency profile) and sustained throughput for bulk inference. Also measure wall power for tok/J.
Oliver Chen: We'll test kernel variants (fused-attn on/off), kv-cache eviction, cuBLAS vs custom kernels. Need AMX driver/firmware and power sensor wiring.
Jake Turner: Draft harness command (example):
```
bench-run --model amx-13b-q4 --seq 2048 --concurrency 12 --duration 900 --power-sensor /dev/ttyUSB0 --telemetry s3://redwood-bench/amx/1932460000/
```
HW Bench Bot: Dry-run uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/amx/1932460000/dryrun.json. Baseline: 125 tok/s @ 305W => ~0.41 tok/J. p95 latency ~310ms at 512 for baseline.
Susan Park: Marketplace needs a reproducible runbook, ops playbook, and co-branded approval from partner + legal signoff for public numbers.
Ying Li: I'll handle co-marketing/legal intake. Need AMX exec sign-off for any public perf claims. I'll send the audit form.
Maria Gomez: Actions: Jake/Oliver produce runbook draft by EOD Thursday. AMX provides drivers/firmware and power sensor contact. Partnerships draft marketplace checklist + NDA addendum.
Oliver Chen: If AMX won't share images, we request lab access. I'll run kernel sweeps: fused-attn, kv-evict, aten kernel v2.3. Will capture per-token latency histograms and mem headroom.
Jake Turner: Adding --sustained ramp mode (15m) to catch thermal throttling and token/s, p50/p95, power_avg, tok_per_joule metrics.
Susan Park: Proposed timeline: 2-week joint engineering window, 1 week legal/marketing, then marketplace listing. AMX ok? @amx-contact
Maria Gomez: Scheduling 30m sync tomorrow 10am PT with AMX eng + bench leads. Agenda: runbook template, kernel ownership, sensor details, timeline. Calendar invite incoming. :thumbsup:
